caseNameFull: American Automobile Insurance Co. of St. Louis, Missouri v. Collins, Committee
attorneys: John F. X. Finn was on the motion for petitioner. With him on the petition was Richard E. Joyce.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit.
